crossRefs.note: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh…
If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

translations.web: The taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.
translations.bsb: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.
translations.kjv: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
translations.asv: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
